stage: before human vote statistics, fitting, predictions, or outcomes
metric_interpretation: First average individual-vote Brier over eligible tracks within each component; then average equally across eligible components. Bootstrap the paired component NB-minus-prior differences, using the same queries and eligibility. Undefined metrics are null with an explicit reason; do not drop abstentions silently.
acquisition_timeout_interpretation: 20-second socket timeout and30-second request wall alarm; not20-second hard wall cap.
source_preprocessing: Official uploader test metadata has upstream global taxonomy/tag-frequency preprocessing. Only the study's vocabulary and model are fit on training components; do not claim all source preprocessing is train-only.
human_annotation_limitations: Exactly three recognized votes, preserving2:1 disagreements. Annotator IDs and cross-record independence/blinding are not established. Human happy judgments are not pairwise music similarity or recommendation utility.
duplicate_limitations: Native track/path duplicates rejected, all native artist/album links grouped. No audio fingerprint or title/alias cross-catalog duplicate identity is available in these two files. Unresolved duplicates across different native artists/albums remain a limitation, not a claimed verified exclusion.
source_separation: No FMA, MusicBrainz, AcousticBrainz labels/models/descriptors or prior inspected splits enter these new fits. Jamendo native IDs cannot prove absence of historical cross-catalog artists; no cross-source untouched-confirmation claim.
rights_boundary: All source metadata and derived research artifacts remain CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 attributed noncommercial research, separate from MIT source and serving. No product integration or deployment. Code alone may be merged after independent review and green CI.
